Dated write-ups of the experiments, newest first. Re-render this page after
adding a new `report_YYYYMMDD.qmd` and it appears here.

```{python}
#| label: listing
#| echo: false
import re
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from IPython.display import Markdown, display


def front_matter_field(text, field):
    """A top-level `field: value` from the YAML front matter, or None."""
    parts = text.split("---", 2)
    if len(parts) < 3:
        return None
    found = re.search(rf'^{field}:\s*"?(.+?)"?\s*$', parts[1], re.M)
    return found.group(1) if found else None


lines = []
for qmd in sorted(Path.cwd().glob("report_*.qmd"), reverse=True):
    stamp = qmd.stem.removeprefix("report_")
    date = datetime.strptime(stamp, "%Y%m%d")
    text = qmd.read_text()

    title = front_matter_field(text, "title") or qmd.stem
    description = front_matter_field(text, "description")

    page = qmd.with_suffix(".html")
    label = f"[{title}]({page.name})" if page.exists() else f"{title} *(not rendered yet)*"

    line = f"- **{date:%B} {date.day}, {date.year}**: {label}"
    if description:
        line += f"  \n  {description}"
    lines.append(line)

display(Markdown("\n".join(lines)))
```
